title: 第27章 公主走丢了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 打弄死他！”柳文彦一群人立即一拥而上，拳脚噼里啪啦往唐画身上招呼。唐画抱着头蜷缩在地上，被打得惨叫连连。唐逸看着这一幕，没有半点怜悯。就是不知道是不是受到前身情绪的影响，他的眼睛莫名有点干涩，心中也是一阵畅爽，竟然被一群男人给暖到了。唐音躲在唐逸的身后，这时悄悄从唐逸身后探出小脑袋，也好奇地看着这一幕。“兄弟，对不起，让你受苦了。”梁绍走过来，抓住唐逸的手，眼睛红红。唐逸嘴角猛地抽了抽，两个男人红着眼睛手牵手，这画面要多诡异就有多诡异好吧！他当场打了一个激灵，和梁绍拉开距离：“说话就说话，别动手动脚的，不知道的还以为老子和你有一腿呢”梁绍一脸伤心：“我们有一腿不是很正常嘛？当年我们可是光着屁股躺过被窝的……”唐逸黑着脸，小时候的黑历史，你扒出来干嘛？几年不见，梁绍越发的不要脸了。“行了，表哥，别打了。”唐逸怕柳文彦一群人真将唐画打死了，虽然唐画该死，但他可不想因为唐画让这群兄弟背上官司。“我曾经就说过，让你们别相信唐画，他说的话一个字都不能信，你们还不相信！”柳文彦很不满，当初唐画接触他们，他就知道唐画没安好心。毕竟姑姑就是被唐画的母亲害死的，那个女人教出来的人能是什么好鸟？结果当时梁绍等人都被唐画的花言巧语所忽悠，没有完全相信他。现在听到柳文彦的话，一群人面色讪讪，妈的我们也没想到唐画竟然会无耻到这种地步啊！“咳咳，好了，今日团聚，别提晦气的事了。”梁绍手搭在唐逸的肩膀上，挤眉弄眼道：“为了给小逸补补身体，我提议，今晚上幻音坊。”“啧啧，听说幻音坊新来了几个大美女，刚好可以抚慰一下小逸受伤的心灵。”众人一听，也都齐齐附和。“嗯，这个可以有，我支持。”“的确，小逸现在这身体，很需要女人滋润下。”“那就赶紧了，晚了可就打不了茶围了。”“……”一群人揽着唐逸就往外走。唐逸眉心直跳，老子谢谢你们啊！我这身体你们给我介绍女人？你们是怕我死得不够快吧？“喂喂喂，我妹还在呢，你们别在我妹妹面前说这些乱七八糟的。”唐逸挣脱梁绍等人的束缚，没好气地道。结果，没人鸟他！梁绍直接将他的小厮叫来，让小厮将唐音送去平远伯府，交给他姐姐暂时照顾几个时辰。唐逸听到这家伙英明的决定，气得要打人，为了上青楼将妹妹送到梁家，传出去人家怎么看他？可惜，反对无效。一群人就这样拥簇着他离开了唐家。而地上衣冠不整头发散乱的唐画，却没人看一眼。“该死的，该死的，你们给我等着！”“等我三元及第，等我平步青云，我要让你们一个个身死族灭！”唐画挣扎着从地上爬起来，怒火滔天。一群纨绔，一群连功名都考不上的败类，竟然也敢瞧不起他。除了出身，他们还有什么比得上他的？唐画咬牙，扫了一眼唐逸破旧的小院，他满脸嫌弃，一甩衣袖离开小院。走了没几步，回头看了一眼唐逸的房间，唐画忽然停下脚步，转身向着唐逸的房间走了过去。房间虽然简陋，但收拾得很整洁，连被子都被折成整洁的豆腐状。唐画虽然有些错愕，却没有太在意，只是当看到桌上的那首词的时候，他瞳孔骤缩，脸上是浓浓的震撼。“春望？”“国破山河在，城春草木深……”等仔细读完这首诗，唐画的脸已经不是震撼，而是开始狰狞起来！“好诗，好诗，好诗啊！”“只是这样一首好诗，唐逸这废物如何能配得上这样一首好诗的？”“他不配啊！”此时此刻，唐画总算明白为何唐逸总是往状元街跑了。这个废物，就是去状元街淘诗的。他想要淘到好诗买下来，在孔诗岚的沈园诗会上赢他？哈哈，那是做梦！“唐逸，你一个废物，只会玷污这首好诗！”“这首诗，现在是我的了！”……皇宫，御书房。皇帝正在批阅奏章，陈貂寺带着太子萧琮走了进来。行礼之后，皇帝看向太子萧琮，有了考校的心思。“太子，对于北境，你怎么看？”太子萧琮作为储君，自然知道如今大炎和北狄正在北境对峙，战事可能一触即发。想到这几日麾下那些大臣的议论，他当即拱手道：“回父皇，儿臣觉得我大炎尚未有和北狄一战的资本，儿臣认为还是求和为好！”“我大炎如今繁华昌盛，不缺少银子和女……”“够了！”炎文帝脸色骤沉，打断太子。他双手叉腰，愤怒在原地转了一圈指着太子道：“你是太子，是储君，你要有自己的判断，而不是被人牵着鼻子走！”“手底下那群人说什么，你就做什么，哪里还有一个储君的样子？”太子吓得跪在地上，拱手道：“父皇息怒，儿臣知错。”炎文帝想到大炎现在的局势，抬手揉了揉眉心道：“罢了，这事也不能完全怪你，但你的身边也不能完全是这些没有家国天下的人。”“朕给你个人，唐逸，礼部侍郎唐敬的儿子，唐逸。”“此人有大才，朕给你个任务，想尽一切办法，将他收为己用。”“有他在，能稳定你的太子之位。”如今大炎表面看似平静，但夺嫡战争却极其激烈。只是因为有他压着，他那些有异心的儿子才不敢轻举妄动，但他压制不了太久了。而太子性格太软，要是镇不住那些权臣，就只会沦落为那些权臣的傀儡。“是，儿臣明白。”太子面色恭敬，心头却已经很不满了。唐逸？没听说过。但就是因为这家伙，父皇才生气的。因此从御书房出来，太子脸色十分难看。侍读太监刚过来，他挥了挥手冷声道：“备马车，孤要出宫！”“另外，给孤查一下唐逸……孤倒要看看，他有什么能耐，能让父皇如此看重！”……“陛下，出事了。”与此同时，御书房中，陈貂寺焦急禀报：“高阳公主在从护国寺回来的路上，自己骑马摆脱了护卫，丢了……”
content_en: Beat him to death!"Liu Wenyan and a group of people immediately swarmed up and greeted Tang Hua with clattering fists and kicks. Tang Hua huddled on the ground holding his head and was beaten so hard that he screamed. Tang Yi looked at this scene without any pity. He just didn't know if he was affected by his predecessor's emotions.His eyes were inexplicably dry, and his heart felt refreshed, and he was actually warmed by the group of men.Tang Yin hid behind Tang Yi, and then quietly poked his head out from behind Tang Yi, looking at this scene curiously, "Brother, I'm sorry for making you suffer."Liang Shao came over, grabbed Tang Yi's hand, his eyes were red. The corners of Tang Yi's mouth twitched sharply, and the two men were holding hands with red eyes. This scene is as weird as you want! He shuddered on the spot, and distanced himself from Liang Shao: "Just talk, don't touch me, people who don't know think I have an affair with you." Liang Shao looked sad: "Isn't it normal for us to have an affair?Back then, we were naked in bed..." Tang Yi had a dark face. Why did you reveal the dark history of his childhood? After not seeing each other for several years, Liang Shao became even more shameless. "Okay, cousin, stop fighting."Tang Yi is afraid that Liu Wenyan and his group will really beat Tang Hua to death. Although Tang Hua deserves to die, he doesn't want these brothers to be sued because of Tang Hua. "I once said that you should not believe Tang Hua. You can't believe a word he says, and you still don't believe it!"Liu Wenyan was very dissatisfied. When Tang Hua contacted them, he knew that Tang Hua had no good intentions. After all, his aunt was killed by Tang Hua's mother. What kind of person could that woman teach? As a result, Liang Shao and others were all tricked by Tang Hua at that time.He was deceived by his sweet words and didn't fully believe him.Now that they heard Liu Wenyan's words, a group of people looked embarrassed. Damn it, we didn't expect Tang Hua to be so shameless!"Ahem, okay, let's not talk about bad luck today.Liang Shao put his hand on Tang Yi's shoulder and winked: "In order to replenish Xiao Yi's health, I suggest that we go to Huanyin Workshop tonight.""Tsk, tsk, I heard that there are some new beauties in Huanyinfang, which can just soothe Xiaoyi's hurt soul.""When everyone heard this, they all agreed. "Well, this is possible, I support it."Indeed, Xiaoyi's current body needs a woman to nourish it.""Then hurry up. If it's too late, you won't be able to fight the tea.""..." A group of people hugged Tang Yi and walked out. Tang Yi's eyebrows were beating, I thank you! You introduce women to me with my body? Are you afraid that I won't die quickly enough? "Hey, hey, hey, my sister is still here, don't say such nonsense in front of my sister.""Tang Yi broke away from the restraints of Liang Shao and others and said angrily. As a result, no one liked him! Liang Shao called his servant directly and asked him to send Tang Yin to Uncle Pingyuan's house and give it to his sister to take care of him temporarily for a few hours. When Tang Yi heard this guy's wise decision, he was so angry that he wanted to hit someone.In order to send his sister to the Liang family, what did people think of him?Unfortunately, the opposition was ineffective.A group of people gathered around him and left the Tang family.No one looked at the disheveled Tang Hua, "Damn it, wait for it!""When I reach the third level, when I rise to the top, I will kill you one by one!""Tang Hua struggled to get up from the ground, furious. A group of dandies, a group of scum who couldn't even get into the exams, dared to look down on him. Apart from their background, what else could they compare to him? Tang Hua gritted his teeth and glanced at Tang Yi's dilapidated courtyard. His face was filled with disgust, and he flicked his sleeves and left the courtyard. After walking a few steps, he looked back at Tang Yi.Tang Hua suddenly stopped and turned towards Tang Yi's room.Although the room was simple, it was tidy, and even the quilt was folded into a neat tofu shape.Although Tang Hua was a little surprised, he didn't pay much attention, but when he saw the poem on the table, his pupils shrank, and his face was filled with shock."The country is broken, the mountains and rivers are there, the city is springy and the vegetation is deep..." After reading this poem carefully, Tang Hua's face was no longer shocked, but became ferocious! "What a poem, what a poem, what a poem!""It's just such a good poem. How can a loser like Tang Yi be worthy of such a good poem?""He doesn't deserve it!""At this moment, Tang Hua finally understood why Tang Yi always ran to Zhuangyuan Street. This trash went to Zhuangyuan Street to look for poems. He wanted to find good poems and buy them, so that he could win against Kong Shilan at the Shenyuan Poetry Competition? Haha, that was a dream! "Tang Yi, you are a trash, you will only tarnish this good poem!"This poem is mine now!""... Imperial Palace, Imperial Study Room. The emperor was reviewing memorials, and Chen Diaosi came in with Prince Xiao Cong. After saluting, the emperor looked at Prince Xiao Cong, thinking about taking the exam. "Prince, what do you think of the Northern Territory?"Prince Xiao Cong, as the crown prince, naturally knew that Dayan and Beidi were now confronting each other in the north, and war might be about to break out. Thinking of the discussions of his ministers in the past few days, he immediately handed over his hands and said: "Going back to my father, I feel that I, Dayan, do not have the capital to fight Beidi, so I think it is better to seek peace!"My Dayan is now prosperous and has no shortage of money and women..." "Enough!"Emperor Yanwen's face suddenly darkened and he interrupted the prince. He put his hands on his hips, turned angrily in a circle and pointed at the prince: "You are the prince and the heir apparent. You must make your own judgment and not be led by others!""You just do whatever the people under you say. How can you still look like a prince?"The prince was so frightened that he knelt on the ground, cupped his hands and said, "Father, please calm down. I understand my mistake."" Emperor Yan Wen thought of Dayan's current situation, raised his hand and rubbed his brows and said: "Well, I can't blame you entirely for this, but you can't be surrounded by these people who have no family, country or world."I give you a person, Tang Yi, the son of Tang Jing, the Minister of Rites. Tang Yi.""This man has great talent. I will give you a task. Try every means to make him your own.""With him here, you can stabilize your position as prince.""Now Dayan seems to be calm on the surface, but the war to seize the rightful son is extremely fierce. It is only because of his suppression that his disaffected sons dare not act rashly, but he cannot suppress it for too long. And the prince's character is too soft. If he cannot suppress those powerful officials, he will only become the puppet of those powerful officials. "Yes, I understand."The prince looked respectful, but he was already very dissatisfied. Tang Yi? Never heard of it. But it was because of this guy that my father was angry.
